original_value: Energy saving has become a major concern for the developed society of our days. This paper presents a Wireless Sensor and Actuator Network (WSAN) designed to provide support to an automatic intelligent system, based on the Internet of Things (IoT), which enables a responsible consumption of energy. The proposed overall system performs an efficient energetic management of devices, machines and processes, optimizing their operation to achieve a reduction in their overall energy usage at any given time. For this purpose, relevant data is collected from intelligent sensors, which are in-stalled at the required locations, as well as from the energy market through the Internet. This information is analysed to provide knowledge about energy utilization, and to improve efficiency. The system takes autonomous decisions automatically, based on the available information and the specific requirements in each case. The proposed system has been implanted and tested in a food factory. Results show a great optimization of energy efficiency and a substantial improvement on energy and costs savings.

result.paraphrase: Energy conservation has become a major concern in modern developed society. This paper presents a Wireless Sensor and Actuator Network (WSAN) intended to support an automatic intelligent Internet of Things (IoT)-based system that enables responsible energy consumption. The proposed integrated system manages the energy use of devices, machines, and processes efficiently, optimizing operation to reduce overall consumption at any given time. To do this, it gathers relevant data from intelligent sensors installed at the necessary locations, as well as from the energy market via the Internet. The information is then analyzed to build knowledge about energy usage and improve efficiency. The system makes autonomous decisions automatically according to the available information and the specific requirements in each case. It has been implemented and tested in a food factory. The results show a major improvement in energy efficiency and a substantial increase in energy and cost savings.
